name: Chert
description: iMessage and FaceTime lines for AI agents: send and receive iMessages through a messaging API with webhooks, and connect LiveKit voice agents to FaceTime audio and video calls.

skills.name: Send and Receive iMessages
skills.description: Send 1:1 and group iMessages with attachments, voice notes and rich links, and receive replies as signed webhooks.

skills.name: Answer FaceTime Calls
skills.description: Connect a LiveKit voice agent to a Chert line to receive inbound or place outbound FaceTime audio and video calls.

skills.name: Send Reactions and Typing
skills.description: Show typing indicators, mark chats read, edit messages and send standard tapback reactions over the API.

skills.name: Stream Message Events
skills.description: Poll, stream over SSE or replay stored events such as message.received and reaction.added for an agent inbox.
